prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a minimal gift-with-purchase skincare offer. Centerpiece is a large Cocoon Hau Giang lotus soothing cleanser refill pouch on the left and a bundle of pink mini lotus products on the right. Background is a plain white catalog field. Surrounding elements: circular pink badges 'MUA 465K' and 'TẶNG 458K', purchase copy 'MUA Túi Refill Sữa Rửa Mặt Sen Hậu Giang 500ml', and gift copy listing '1 Nước Sen Hậu Giang 50ml 2 Nước Tẩy Trang Sen Hậu Giang 50ml 2 Tinh Chất Xịt Dưỡng Sen Hậu Giang 50ml'. Keep the minimalist layout, exact offer wording, and clean packshot alignment. Technical style: high fidelity retail poster design with realistic packshots, soft studio catalog lighting, even product illumination and crisp e-commerce readability, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
